input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 is the only assignment provision (no change-of-control language appears anywhere, so TrueLink has no CoC termination or re-pricing right — that limb is satisfied). However, the clause requires the other party's prior written approval with no reasonableness standard and, critically, no carve-out for assignment to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets; only a "financially responsible affiliate" carve-out exists. That fails the fallback on both material terms (successor assignment on notice, and consent not unreasonably withheld) and leaves TrueLink able to block our M&A or reorganisation. Redline adds the Client successor carve-out on notice, the reasonableness standard, a bar on TrueLink assigning to a competitor of ours, and confirms a change of control of Client is not an assignment and triggers no TrueLink right; the mutual structure of the clause is otherwise preserved.

proposal.summary: Add Client successor/M&A assignment carve-out, reasonableness standard on consent, no-competitor limit on TrueLink, and confirm change of control is not an assignment or termination trigger.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets on notice, and made the consent standard "not unreasonably withheld", since our playbook does not permit our corporate reorganisations or M&A to be blocked. We have also confirmed that a change of control of Client is not an assignment and gives TrueLink no termination or re-pricing right, and that TrueLink may not assign to a competitor of ours; if helpful we can accept a mutual successor-assignment-on-notice formulation instead.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed, except no such approval shall be required for (a) an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or (b) an assignment by Client, upon written notice to TrueLink, to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity. TrueLink shall not assign or transfer this Agreement to a competitor of Client. No change of control of Client shall be deemed an assignment requiring approval or give rise to any right of TrueLink to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
